snippet.title: Sonic Forces Untold - Darkest of Days Visual Novel // SAGE 2025 Teaser
snippet.description:
SAGE Booth ► https://sonicfangameshq.com/forums/showcase/sonic-forces-untold-darkest-of-days-visual-novel.2520/

In a world devastated by Sonic’s disappearance, his friends face not only grief, but also increasingly darker threats. This is a dramatic visual novel, where each route dives into loss, bonds, and romance as every character struggles with their feelings for Sonic and the hope of bringing him back. Play through the perspective of each character experiencing their emotions, conflicts, and choices in the search for love, closure, and a future where Sonic might return.

Developed by 
kaiqueMiya + vivigrisa + oyurilobato + fabricio.lima.071
